sql: SELECT v AS k1,v AS k2,grouping_id() AS gid,count(*) AS n FROM (VALUES(CAST('-0' AS FLOAT)),(CAST('0' AS FLOAT)),(CAST(NULL AS FLOAT))) t(v) GROUP BY ROLLUP(k1,k2)  ORDER BY gid,k1,k2,n

SELECT v AS k1,v AS k2,grouping_id() AS gid,count(*) AS n FROM (VALUES(CAST('-0' AS FLOAT)),(CAST('0' AS FLOAT)),(CAST(NULL AS FLOAT))) t(v) GROUP BY ROLLUP(k1,k2) HAVING k1 IS NULL AND k2 IS NULL ORDER BY gid,k1,k2,n
